snippet.title: Dark Merge Farm — Launch Trailer | Out Now on Google Play
snippet.description:
▶ Play free on Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ArrugaCorp.DarkMerge&utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=always_on&referrer=utm_source%3Dyoutube%26utm_medium%3Dvideo_description Dark Merge Farm is out now on Google Play!

A cozy merge farm in a dark fantasy world. Clear the Mist, light the way, merge crops and tools, grow your farm and rebuild a forgotten village.

Available in the US, UK, Canada, Australia, France, Poland, Lithuania, Cyprus and Kazakhstan.
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ArrugaCorp.DarkMerge
Website: https://arrugames.com

Music: Dark Toys — SYBS (YouTube Audio Library)

#DarkMergeFarm #MergeGame #FarmGame
